description: This file defines the StaticVersionGenerator class, which implements a version generator that returns a static version code, either provided via a lambda or defaulting to 1.

classes.name: StaticVersionGenerator
classes.description: A version generator that provides a static version code, configurable via constructor.

methods.name: getVersionCode
methods.description: Returns the static version code provided by the lambda.

methods.name: isValidForEnvironment
methods.description: Indicates that this generator is valid for any environment.
